package.name: panda_control_node
package.description: Minimal single-arm OpenSoT control node for the Franka Panda - a controlled ablation against tiago_control_node's whole-body stack: same OpenSoT solver and control-loop shape, no dual-arm/base/collision-avoidance complexity, to isolate whether TIAGo's whole-body control is the source of policy-performance problems. Reuses tiago_control_node's pose_commander.py directly.
